name: structural-build-staging
body: The build-pipeline half that compiles and stages the bundled structural scanner: `build.rs` builds `structfrontend` and copies it to `target/<profile>/frontends` alongside the seven language frontends (`rust.build_script_build.build_frontends`, `rust.build_script_build.main`). The formula/release surfaces that ship it in the base package (`Formula/scanner.rb`, `install.sh`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`) are non-graph maintainer edits — see `solution.note.structural-scanner-oroboros`. `rust.build_script_build.copy_dir` is a helper rather than an implementing unit — see `solution.note.structural-build-staging-copy-dir-reconciliation`.
